prompt: Workflows from first-time outside contributors keep running before anyone reviews them. Which org setting addresses exactly this?
explanation: The approval setting gates workflow runs from new external contributors until a maintainer with write access approves them. Read-only tokens limit blast radius but do not withhold execution, and disabling Actions forgoes the project’s automation outright.

options.text: Requiring approval for workflows from first-time contributors
Disabling Actions on all public repositories
Setting default workflow permissions to read-only
